name: Totemia Cursed Marbles
author: Addicting Games
description: Totemia Cursed marbles is a free marble-shooter game. The curse is real and you are our last hope. Stop the marbles before they stack up and bring us down. Totemia Cursed Marbles is a shooter game where players defend the entrance to their tribes' shrine from the unwelcome advance of rainbow colored spherical invaders. You can save the day by making sure that you line up the color of the marble you fire with at least two like colored marbles in the line. Practice ytour timing and your accuracey. Take out marbles strategically or fire off a volley of hail Mary's. This cute-shooter game lets you make the choice what kind of player you will be, but however, you play the game make sure you play to win. Pay attention to the marbles in the line, sometimes you will see bonus marbles, power-ups, and other kinds of special marbles that will allow you to optimize your chances of survival. Defend your base and keep the entrance safe or these marbled invaders will roll all over you, your friends, your family, the tribe, and everything you hold dear. Load up and let's go with Totemia Cursed Marbles. A true gamers game.
